question: how many credits is the comp sci minor vs the data science minor? trying to see which one is less work
answer:
Neither minor page gives an exact credit total. The college says a minor must include 16–24 credits, including non-General Education prerequisites and excluding lab science course credits [4]. So the pages don’t establish which minor has fewer credits [1][2][4].

The Computer Science minor requires 3 courses from Group 1 and 2 from Group 2 [1]. Group 1: CMPS 130 SCI PROBLEM SOLVING-PYTHON; 147 COMPUTER SCIENCE I; 148 COMPUTER SCIENCE II; 220 ASSEMBLY LANGUAGE PROGRAMMING; 231 DATA STRUCTURES; 240 DATA ANALYTICS IN PYTHON; 285 MOBILE DEVELOPMENT; 305 CYBER SECURITY; 310 BIG DATA PROGRAMMING; 311 OPERATING SYSTEMS; 315 THE LINUX ENVIRONMENT; 320 MACHINE LEARNING; 327 NETWORK PROGRAMMING; 331 ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE; unnamed catalog entry; 337 COMPUTER VISION; 342 COMPUTER GRAPHICS; 345 ANALYSIS OF ALGORITHMS; 350 FINANCIAL MODELING; 357 THE .NET ENVIRONMENT; 361 SOFTWARE DESIGN; 364 DATABASE DESIGN; 366 ORGANIZATION OF PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES; 369 WEB APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT; 370 CYBER AND NETWORK DEFENSE; 373 OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING; 450 SENIOR PROJECT. Group 2: 305, 310, 311, 315, 320, 327, 331, unnamed catalog entry, 337, 342, 345, 350, 357, 361, 364, 366, 369, 370, 373, 450 (same titles as above) [1]. All 300-level courses have prerequisites; sequences are CMPS 147 + 148 + 231, or CMPS 130 + 240. All 300-level courses are available with Sequence 1; a subset with Sequence 2 [1].

Data Science requires CMPS 130, CMPS 240, DATA 101 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE, DATA 301 DATA ANALYSIS & VISUALIZATION, and one elective: BADM 225 MANAGEMENT STATISTICS; BIOL 354 RESEARCH DESIGN & STATISTICS; MATH 353 STATISTICS; MATH 370 APPLIED STATISTICS; POLI 316 POLITICAL ANALYSIS; PSYC 242 STATISTICS; SOCI 308 DATA ANALYSIS IN SOCIOLOGY; or SWRK 307 SOCIAL WORK RESEARCH METHODS [2]. The pages don’t say which takes less work; the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising) may help compare: success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441, D-207 [1][2].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-MN-CMPS) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-MN-DSCI) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1)

question: what do i need to take for the poli sci minor
